_meta.purpose: Curated academic definitions for taxonomy group cards (L0/L1/L2/L3). Keyed by 'Domain|||Level|||Title'. The taxonomy browser prefers these over auto-generated templates. English definitions use genus-differentia form with a boundary clause; Korean gives a concise scholarly gloss. 'term_revised' proposes a clearer label; 'note' records MECE/placement issues; 'source' cites a reputable reference.

Science|||L1|||AI science and research.english: The reference domain comprising scientific inquiry into artificial intelligence: the formulation of learning problems, the design and analysis of models and algorithms, empirical evaluation, and the theoretical and cognitive foundations of intelligent behavior. It denotes AI as a body of knowledge and method, distinct from its engineering implementation (Technology) and its public regulation (Policy).
Science|||L1|||AI science and research.korean: 인공지능을 과학적 탐구 대상으로 다루는 참조 영역으로, 학습 문제의 정식화, 모델·알고리즘의 설계와 분석, 실증적 평가, 지능 행동의 이론적·인지적 기초를 포괄한다. 공학적 구현(Technology) 및 공공 규제(Policy)와 구별된다.
Science|||L1|||AI science and research.source: Russell & Norvig, Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (4th ed., 2021)

Technology|||L1|||AI technology and inve.english: The reference domain comprising AI as engineered, application-enabling capability: inventive functions, system architectures, hardware and software components, and deployable technical methods. It treats AI as a patentable artifact and operational technology, distinct from scientific claims (Science) and governance discourse (Policy).
Technology|||L1|||AI technology and inve.korean: 인공지능을 응용을 가능케 하는 공학적 산물로 다루는 참조 영역으로, 발명적 기능, 시스템 아키텍처, 하드웨어·소프트웨어 구성요소, 배치 가능한 기술적 방법을 포괄한다. 과학적 주장(Science) 및 거버넌스 담론(Policy)과 구별된다.
Technology|||L1|||AI technology and inve.source: Hennessy & Patterson, Computer Architecture: A Quantitative Approach (6th ed., 2019)

Policy|||L1|||AI policy and governance.english: The reference domain comprising public action and institutional design through which states, agencies, and international bodies frame AI as an object of regulation, coordination, and accountability. It encompasses governance instruments, regulatory choices, and socioeconomic agenda-setting, distinct from scientific (Science) and engineering (Technology) framings.
Policy|||L1|||AI policy and governance.korean: 국가·기관·국제기구가 인공지능을 규제·조정·책무성의 대상으로 구성하는 공공 행위와 제도 설계의 참조 영역으로, 거버넌스 수단·규제 선택·사회경제적 의제설정을 포괄한다. 과학(Science)·공학(Technology) 틀과 구별된다.

Science|||L2|||AI alignment and control.english: Research on ensuring that capable AI systems pursue intended human objectives and remain correctable and supervisable, including value alignment, corrigibility, scalable oversight, and avoidance of specification gaming. Bounded to the technical control problem rather than fairness or legal liability.
Science|||L2|||AI alignment and control.korean: 유능한 AI가 의도된 인간 목표를 추구하고 교정·감독 가능하도록 보장하는 연구로, 가치 정렬, 교정가능성, 확장가능 감독, 명세 악용 회피를 포함한다. 공정성·법적 책임이 아닌 기술적 통제 문제로 한정된다.
Science|||L2|||AI alignment and control.source: Russell, Human Compatible (2019); Amodei et al., Concrete Problems in AI Safety (2016, arXiv:1606.06565)

Science|||L2|||AI alignment, fairness, a.english: Cross-cutting normative research that links technical alignment with fairness guarantees and the allocation of legal responsibility for AI behavior. Distinguished from pure alignment by its joint treatment of distributive fairness and liability.
Science|||L2|||AI alignment, fairness, a.korean: 기술적 정렬을 공정성 보장 및 AI 행위에 대한 법적 책임 배분과 연결하는 교차적 규범 연구. 분배적 공정성과 책임을 함께 다룬다는 점에서 순수 정렬 연구와 구별된다.
Science|||L2|||AI alignment, fairness, a.note: Overlaps with 'AI alignment and control' and the fairness clusters; merge-review candidate.
Science|||L2|||AI alignment, fairness, a.source: Barocas, Hardt & Narayanan, Fairness and Machine Learning (2019)

Science|||L2|||AI education and learning.english: Research on AI applied to education, including intelligent tutoring systems and learning analytics, and on the cultivation of AI competence. A single-node cluster that sits uneasily within the science reference space.
Science|||L2|||AI education and learning.korean: 지능형 튜터링 시스템·학습분석 등 교육에 적용된 AI와 AI 역량 함양에 관한 연구. 과학 참조공간 내 단일 노드 군집으로 위치가 불안정하다.
Science|||L2|||AI education and learning.note: Singleton (1 node); placement review / merge candidate (e.g., into applications cluster).
Science|||L2|||AI education and learning.source: Holmes et al., Artificial Intelligence in Education (2019)

Science|||L2|||AI governance, assurance,.english: Heterogeneous research linking AI governance mechanisms, assurance and audit methods, and applied deployments across sectors. The broadest science cluster; its internal heterogeneity limits definitional sharpness.
Science|||L2|||AI governance, assurance,.korean: AI 거버넌스 기제, 보증·감사 방법, 부문별 응용 배치를 아우르는 이질적 연구. 가장 광범위한 과학 군집으로 내부 이질성이 정의의 예리함을 제한한다.
Science|||L2|||AI governance, assurance,.source: Floridi et al., AI4People (2018, Minds & Machines)

Science|||L2|||AI innovation and economi.english: Study of the dynamics of AI-driven innovation and the economic and institutional structures that shape AI research and diffusion.
Science|||L2|||AI innovation and economi.korean: AI 주도 혁신의 동학과 AI 연구·확산을 형성하는 경제적·제도적 구조에 관한 연구.

Science|||L2|||AI law, liability, and in.english: Legal scholarship on AI, covering liability for autonomous-system harms, regulatory classification, and intellectual-property questions such as authorship and patentability of AI-generated outputs.
Science|||L2|||AI law, liability, and in.korean: 자율시스템 피해 책임, 규제 분류, AI 산출물의 저작·특허 가능성 등 지식재산 문제를 다루는 AI 법학 연구.
Science|||L2|||AI law, liability, and in.source: Calo, Artificial Intelligence Policy: A Primer and Roadmap (2017, UC Davis Law Review)

Science|||L2|||AI safety and security.english: Research on preventing unintended harmful behavior of AI systems (safety) and on protecting them from adversarial or malicious compromise (security), including robustness, monitoring, and threat modeling.
Science|||L2|||AI safety and security.korean: AI의 의도치 않은 유해 행동을 예방하는 안전(safety)과 적대적·악의적 침해로부터 보호하는 보안(security) 연구로, 강건성·모니터링·위협모델링을 포함한다.
Science|||L2|||AI safety and security.source: Hendrycks et al., Unsolved Problems in ML Safety (2021, arXiv:2109.13916)

Science|||L2|||AI, rights, and biometric.english: Research on biometric AI and its implications for fundamental rights such as privacy and non-discrimination. As a single-node science cluster it overlaps the policy domain's larger rights-and-biometrics cluster.
Science|||L2|||AI, rights, and biometric.korean: 생체인식 AI와 프라이버시·비차별 등 기본권 함의에 관한 연구. 과학 영역의 단일 노드로, 정책 영역의 동명 대형 군집과 중복된다.
Science|||L2|||AI, rights, and biometric.note: Singleton (1 node); likely belongs in Policy; cross-domain duplication.
Science|||L2|||AI, rights, and biometric.source: European Union Agency for Fundamental Rights, Facial Recognition Technology (2019)

Science|||L2|||Adversarial ML and inform.english: Study of adversarial attacks on and defenses for machine-learning models (evasion, poisoning, extraction) together with information-level harms such as manipulation enabled by ML.
Science|||L2|||Adversarial ML and inform.korean: 기계학습 모델에 대한 적대적 공격·방어(회피·오염·추출)와 ML이 가능케 하는 조작 등 정보 차원의 해악을 연구한다.
Science|||L2|||Adversarial ML and inform.source: Biggio & Roli, Wild Patterns (2018, Pattern Recognition); Goodfellow et al., Explaining and Harnessing Adversarial Examples (2015, arXiv:1412.6572)

Science|||L2|||Algorithmic fairness and.english: Research on defining, measuring, and mitigating unfair disparate treatment or impact in algorithmic decisions, and on mechanisms (audits, recourse) that establish accountability for those decisions.
Science|||L2|||Algorithmic fairness and.korean: 알고리즘 의사결정의 불공정한 차별적 처우·영향을 정의·측정·완화하고, 감사·시정 등 책무성 기제를 다루는 연구.
Science|||L2|||Algorithmic fairness and.source: Barocas, Hardt & Narayanan, Fairness and Machine Learning (2019)

Science|||L2|||Algorithmic fairness and.english: Methods for detecting and reducing bias in algorithmic systems through pre-, in-, and post-processing interventions. A single-node cluster nearly duplicating 'Algorithmic fairness and accountability'.
Science|||L2|||Algorithmic fairness and.korean: 전처리·학습중·후처리 개입으로 알고리즘 시스템의 편향을 탐지·저감하는 방법. 'Algorithmic fairness and accountability'와 거의 중복되는 단일 노드 군집.
Science|||L2|||Algorithmic fairness and.note: Near-duplicate singleton; merge into 'Algorithmic fairness and accountability'.
Science|||L2|||Algorithmic fairness and.source: Mehrabi et al., A Survey on Bias and Fairness in ML (2021, ACM CSUR)

Science|||L2|||Automated decision-making.english: Study of systems that make or materially support consequential decisions with limited human intervention, including agent architectures and decision pipelines.
Science|||L2|||Automated decision-making.korean: 제한된 인간 개입으로 중대한 의사결정을 수행·보조하는 시스템 연구로, 에이전트 아키텍처와 의사결정 파이프라인을 포함한다.
Science|||L2|||Automated decision-making.source: Russell & Norvig, AIMA (4th ed., 2021), ch. on intelligent agents

Science|||L2|||Autonomous agents and for.english: Research on autonomous agents and the formal mathematics of sequential decision-making, including Markov decision processes, planning, and game-theoretic models.
Science|||L2|||Autonomous agents and for.korean: 자율 에이전트와 순차적 의사결정의 형식 수학(마르코프 결정과정·계획수립·게임이론 모델)에 관한 연구.

Science|||L2|||Cognitive biases and deci.english: Study of human judgment under uncertainty (heuristics and systematic biases) and of normative and descriptive decision theory relevant to modeling and evaluating intelligent choice.
Science|||L2|||Cognitive biases and deci.korean: 불확실성하 인간 판단(휴리스틱·체계적 편향)과 지능적 선택을 모델링·평가하는 데 관련된 규범적·기술적 의사결정 이론에 관한 연구.
Science|||L2|||Cognitive biases and deci.source: Kahneman, Thinking, Fast and Slow (2011); Tversky & Kahneman (1974, Science)

Science|||L2|||Cognitive science and phi.english: Interdisciplinary study of cognition, mental representation, and consciousness, and the philosophical foundations of mind that inform conceptions of machine intelligence.
Science|||L2|||Cognitive science and phi.korean: 인지, 정신적 표상, 의식에 관한 학제적 연구와 기계지능 개념에 영향을 주는 심리철학적 기초.
Science|||L2|||Cognitive science and phi.source: Thagard, Mind: Introduction to Cognitive Science (2nd ed., 2005)

Science|||L2|||Complexity and bio-inspir.english: Study of complex adaptive systems and nature-inspired computation, including evolutionary algorithms, swarm intelligence, and other biologically motivated methods.
Science|||L2|||Complexity and bio-inspir.korean: 복잡 적응계와 진화 알고리즘·군집지능 등 자연에서 영감을 받은 계산을 연구한다.

Science|||L2|||Computational science and.english: Use of computation, numerical methods, and simulation to model and study scientific phenomena. Appears in both Science and Technology, blurring the domain boundary.
Science|||L2|||Computational science and.korean: 과학 현상을 모델링·연구하기 위한 계산·수치해석·시뮬레이션의 사용. 과학과 기술 양 영역에 등장하여 영역 경계를 흐린다.
Science|||L2|||Computational science and.note: Cross-domain duplicate (also in Technology); decide canonical home.

Science|||L2|||Computer vision and multi.english: Research on machine perception of images, video, and combined modalities, including recognition, reconstruction, and multimodal representation.
Science|||L2|||Computer vision and multi.korean: 이미지·비디오 및 복합 모달리티의 기계 지각에 관한 연구로, 인식·복원·멀티모달 표현을 포함한다.
Science|||L2|||Computer vision and multi.source: Szeliski, Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications (2nd ed., 2022)

Science|||L2|||Computing systems and inf.english: Study of the hardware and software systems and infrastructure that enable computation, including architectures, operating systems, and distributed systems.
Science|||L2|||Computing systems and inf.korean: 계산을 가능케 하는 하드웨어·소프트웨어 시스템과 인프라(아키텍처·운영체제·분산시스템)에 관한 연구.

Science|||L2|||Data governance and law.english: Research on the legal and institutional frameworks governing data collection, sharing, ownership, and protection as they bear on AI research.
Science|||L2|||Data governance and law.korean: AI 연구와 관련된 데이터 수집·공유·소유·보호를 규율하는 법적·제도적 틀에 관한 연구.
Science|||L2|||Data governance and law.note: Borders the Policy cluster 'Data governance and digital sovereignty'.

Science|||L2|||Ethics and normative AI t.english: Normative inquiry into the moral principles that should govern the design, deployment, and use of AI, including frameworks of beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, and justice.
Science|||L2|||Ethics and normative AI t.korean: AI의 설계·배치·사용을 규율해야 할 도덕 원칙(선행·악행금지·자율성·정의)에 관한 규범적 탐구.
Science|||L2|||Ethics and normative AI t.source: Floridi & Cowls, A Unified Framework of Five Principles for AI in Society (2019, HDSR)

Science|||L2|||Foundations of complex sy.english: Theoretical foundations drawn from complex-systems science and physical theory that underpin models of computation and emergent behavior.
Science|||L2|||Foundations of complex sy.korean: 계산과 창발 행동의 모델을 뒷받침하는 복잡계 과학·물리 이론의 이론적 기초.

Science|||L2|||Language modeling and NLP.english: Research on the computational modeling of natural language, including syntax, semantics, and statistical and neural language models for understanding and generation.
Science|||L2|||Language modeling and NLP.korean: 구문·의미 및 이해·생성을 위한 통계·신경 언어모델을 포함한 자연어의 계산적 모델링 연구.
Science|||L2|||Language modeling and NLP.note: Near-duplicate of 'Language models and generative NLP'; merge-review.
Science|||L2|||Language modeling and NLP.source: Jurafsky & Martin, Speech and Language Processing (3rd ed. draft, 2023)

Science|||L2|||Language models and gener.english: Research on large language models and generative natural-language processing, including pretraining, in-context learning, and text generation.
Science|||L2|||Language models and gener.korean: 대형 언어모델과 생성형 자연어처리(사전학습·문맥내 학습·텍스트 생성)에 관한 연구.
Science|||L2|||Language models and gener.term_revised: Large language models and generative NLP
Science|||L2|||Language models and gener.note: Near-duplicate of 'Language modeling and NLP'; consolidate.
Science|||L2|||Language models and gener.source: Brown et al., Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (2020, NeurIPS)

Science|||L2|||Machine learning methods.english: Study of algorithms that improve at tasks by learning from data, spanning supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement paradigms and their canonical task formulations.
Science|||L2|||Machine learning methods.korean: 데이터로부터 학습하여 과제 수행을 개선하는 알고리즘 연구로, 지도·비지도·강화 패러다임과 표준 과제 정식화를 아우른다.
Science|||L2|||Machine learning methods.source: Murphy, Probabilistic Machine Learning: An Introduction (2022)

Science|||L2|||Mathematical and informat.english: The mathematical and information-theoretic basis of learning and inference, including probability, statistics, information theory, and statistical learning theory.
Science|||L2|||Mathematical and informat.korean: 확률·통계·정보이론·통계적 학습이론 등 학습과 추론의 수학적·정보이론적 기초.
Science|||L2|||Mathematical and informat.source: Cover & Thomas, Elements of Information Theory (2nd ed., 2006); Shalev-Shwartz & Ben-David, Understanding Machine Learning (2014)

Science|||L2|||Model training pathologie.english: Study of failure modes that arise during model training, such as overfitting, optimization instability, vanishing or exploding gradients, and shortcut or spurious-correlation learning.
Science|||L2|||Model training pathologie.korean: 과적합, 최적화 불안정, 기울기 소실·폭주, 지름길·허위상관 학습 등 모델 훈련 중 발생하는 실패 양식에 관한 연구.
Science|||L2|||Model training pathologie.source: Goodfellow, Bengio & Courville, Deep Learning (2016), ch. 7-8

Science|||L2|||Moral philosophy and econ.english: Foundations in moral philosophy and economic theory that bear on AI's normative status and welfare consequences, including consequentialist, deontological, and welfare-economic frameworks.
Science|||L2|||Moral philosophy and econ.korean: 결과주의·의무론·후생경제 등 AI의 규범적 지위와 후생 결과에 관련된 도덕철학·경제이론의 기초.
Science|||L2|||Moral philosophy and econ.source: Parfit, Reasons and Persons (1984); Sen, Collective Choice and Social Welfare (1970)

Science|||L2|||Neural networks and deep.english: Research on multilayer neural network models and the methods for training them, encompassing architectures, optimization, and representation learning under the deep-learning paradigm.
Science|||L2|||Neural networks and deep.korean: 다층 신경망 모델과 그 훈련 방법에 관한 연구로, 심층학습 패러다임 하의 아키텍처·최적화·표현학습을 포괄한다.

Science|||L2|||Optimization, inference,.english: Methods for optimizing model parameters, performing probabilistic inference, and evaluating model performance, including convex and stochastic optimization and statistical evaluation protocols.
Science|||L2|||Optimization, inference,.korean: 모델 매개변수 최적화, 확률적 추론, 성능 평가 방법으로, 볼록·확률적 최적화와 통계적 평가 프로토콜을 포함한다.
Science|||L2|||Optimization, inference,.source: Boyd & Vandenberghe, Convex Optimization (2004); Bishop, Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning (2006)

Science|||L2|||Representation learning a.english: Study of methods that learn informative, often low-dimensional representations or embeddings of data that support downstream learning and transfer.
Science|||L2|||Representation learning a.korean: 하류 학습·전이를 지원하는 정보성 있는(흔히 저차원) 데이터 표현·임베딩을 학습하는 방법에 관한 연구.
Science|||L2|||Representation learning a.source: Bengio, Courville & Vincent, Representation Learning: A Review (2013, IEEE TPAMI)

Science|||L2|||Robotics, embodied AI, an.english: Research on physically embodied intelligence, including robotics, sensorimotor control, and bio-inspired systems that perceive and act in the physical world.
Science|||L2|||Robotics, embodied AI, an.korean: 로보틱스·감각운동 제어 및 물리세계에서 지각·행동하는 생체모방 시스템 등 물리적으로 체화된 지능에 관한 연구.
Science|||L2|||Robotics, embodied AI, an.source: Siciliano & Khatib (eds.), Springer Handbook of Robotics (2nd ed., 2016)

Science|||L2|||STS and algorithmic gover.english: Science-and-technology-studies scholarship analyzing how algorithmic systems are produced, contested, and governed, and how they become embedded in social and institutional practice.
Science|||L2|||STS and algorithmic gover.korean: 알고리즘 시스템이 어떻게 생산·경합·통치되고 사회·제도적 실천에 착근되는지를 분석하는 과학기술학(STS) 연구.
Science|||L2|||STS and algorithmic gover.source: Jasanoff, States of Knowledge (2004); Seaver, Algorithms as Culture (2017, Big Data & Society)

Science|||L2|||Statistical modeling and.english: Statistical models and data-mining methods for discovering structure in and making predictions from data, including regression, classification, clustering, and pattern discovery.

Risks|||L2|||Deceptive alignment.note: Singleton; a specific alignment failure mode.

Risks|||L2|||Monitoring and interpretabi.note: Near-duplicate of 'Lack of transparency or interpretability'; merge-review.

Risks|||L2|||Other.korean: 정의된 하위범주에 아직 배정되지 않은 악용 레코드를 위한 미분류 잔여 버킷.

Risks|||L2|||Oversight and evaluation li.english: Risks from inadequate human oversight and evaluation capacity to catch unsafe or capable behavior before harm.

Risks|||L2|||Specification and objective.source: Amodei et al., Concrete Problems in AI Safety (2016)
